title: MIDNIGHT DUEL
oneLiner: Choose Batman or The Flash, then fight a rooftop best-of-three duel.
mechanics: Before fighting: Left/Right chooses your character, A locks, B unlocks. In 2P each person confirms independently; 1P shows a CPU opponent.
Move and control spacing; hold away to guard.
A punches, B kicks; Down+A sweeps, Down+B uses a metered special.
Jump with Up and attack in the air; low attacks beat standing guard, overhead kicks beat crouch guard.
Five-frame jab and eleven-frame kick startups expose meaningful recovery; one hit per attack with hitstop and knockback.
Batman throws a batarang; Flash performs a speed dash.
First to two rounds wins; CPU opponent in 1P, both controllers in 2P.
artDirection: Original articulated pixel characters around 60 pixels tall with named-character masks, cape, lightning emblem, pointed cowl and action-specific silhouettes. Layered moonlit rooftop and perspective floor. Complete original animation sets with baked frame metadata.
lose: Lose two rounds to the CPU; versus ends with the winning player.
scoring: 10 points per damage, 50 bonus for linked hits, 500 per round; player scores are independent.
note: Original fan-art; character rights remain with their owners.
